title: I made a first-person voxel roguelite just for fun: a princess who got tired of waiting to be rescued
author: ZanoCapa
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'd like to share **Runess**, a game I've been making purely for my own enjoyment. It's a first-person 3D roguelite with voxel graphics. A princess gets tired of waiting for a knight to come and save her, so she leaves her tower on her own and fights her way down the castle, floor by floor. She starts with a single spell and picks up gifts and curses along the way. Every staircase is guarded by a boss.  
It borrows heavily from the big names of the genre, *The Binding of Isaac* and *Dead Cells* above all.

**A heads-up:** the game deals with some difficult themes that might upset some players. There are content warnings at the start, so please read them before you play.

**About AI:** I wrote the game with a lot of help from Claude, but this isn't a "one-prompt game". It's a long, ongoing project built piece by piece: I make the design decisions, playtest everything and keep reworking whatever doesn't feel right.

I'm Italian and my English is pretty bad, so Claude helped me with both this post and the game's English translation. Please forgive any odd phrasing!

I'm here to gather opinions, suggestions and bug reports. I'd be really happy to get any kind of feedback, whether it's something you liked, something that annoyed you, or something that broke.

You can find it here: [https://yanez86.itch.io/runess](https://yanez86.itch.io/runess)

Thanks for reading!
